description: This file defines a PHP class LeaveBalanceModel that models leave balance data within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It implements serialization and normalization to facilitate API responses, wrapping data from the LeaveBalance entity.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceModel
classes.description: A model class for representing leave balance information in API responses, wrapping the LeaveBalance entity data and providing serialization attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveBalanceModel with a LeaveBalance entity, setting up serialization filters and attribute mappings.
